typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		position_nbr as string,
		effdt as date,
		descr as string,
		business_unit as string,
		deptid as string,
		jobcode as string,
		posn_status as string,
		job_share as string,
		reports_to as string,
		eff_status as string,
		descrshort as string,
		budgeted_posn as string,
		confidential_posn as string,
		key_position as string,
		max_head_count as short,
		update_incumbents as string,
		location as string,
		company as string,
		std_hrs_default as integer,
		union_cd as string,
		shift as string,
		reg_temp as string,
		full_part_time as string,
		barg_unit as string,
		seasonal as string,
		sal_plan_dflt as string,
		grade_dflt as string,
		acct_cd as string,
		med_percent as short,
		mos_percent as short,
		upp_percent as short,
		descrlong as string,
		fte as integer,
		r as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Declare @full_load varchar(1)  select  @full_load = full_partial_load from ps_hcm.cfg_table_load_parameter  SELECT * FROM ( 	SELECT   		position_nbr,  		effdt,  		descr,  		business_unit,  		deptid,  		jobcode,  		posn_status,  		job_share,  		reports_to,  		eff_status,  		descrshort,  		budgeted_posn,  		confidential_posn,  		key_position,  		max_head_count,  		update_incumbents, 		location, 		company,  		std_hrs_default, 		union_cd, 		shift, 		reg_temp, 		full_part_time, 		barg_unit, 		seasonal, 		sal_plan_dflt, 		grade_dflt, 		acct_cd, 		med_percent, 		mos_percent, 		upp_percent, 		descrlong, 		fte, 		dense_rank() over(partition by position_nbr order by effdt desc) as r 	FROM [ps_hcm].[ps_position_data] ) p WHERE r=1 and ( @full_load = \'F\' or datepart(dw,getdate()) = 1 or effdt>=dateadd(dd,-90,getdate())  ) ORDER BY p.position_nbr',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		position_key as integer,
		position_nbr as string,
		effective_from as date,
		description as string,
		business_unit as string,
		department as string,
		job_code as string,
		position_status as string,
		job_share as string,
		reports_to as string,
		reports_to_key as integer,
		effective_status as string,
		description_short as string,
		is_budgeted_position as string,
		is_confidential_position as string,
		is_key_position as string,
		max_head_count as short,
		update_incumbents as string,
		location as string,
		company as string,
		company_key as integer,
		std_hrs_default as integer,
		union_code as string,
		union_key as integer,
		shift as string,
		reg_temp as string,
		employment_type_key as integer,
		full_part_time as string,
		barg_unit as string,
		seasonal as string,
		sal_plan_dflt as string,
		grade_dflt as string,
		acct_cd as string,
		med_percent as short,
		mos_percent as short,
		upp_percent as short,
		description_long as string,
		fte as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from hr.dim_position',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupdimpositionLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupdimpositionLKPTABLE lookup(OLEDBSource@position_nbr == LookupdimpositionLKPTABLE@position_nbr,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookupdimposition
Lookupdimposition select(mapColumn(
		position_nbr = OLEDBSource@position_nbr,
		effdt = effdt,
		descr = descr,
		business_unit = OLEDBSource@business_unit,
		deptid = deptid,
		jobcode = jobcode,
		posn_status = posn_status,
		job_share = OLEDBSource@job_share,
		reports_to = OLEDBSource@reports_to,
		eff_status = eff_status,
		descrshort = descrshort,
		budgeted_posn = budgeted_posn,
		confidential_posn = confidential_posn,
		key_position = key_position,
		max_head_count = OLEDBSource@max_head_count,
		update_incumbents = OLEDBSource@update_incumbents,
		location = OLEDBSource@location,
		company = OLEDBSource@company,
		std_hrs_default = OLEDBSource@std_hrs_default,
		union_cd = union_cd,
		shift = OLEDBSource@shift,
		reg_temp = OLEDBSource@reg_temp,
		full_part_time = OLEDBSource@full_part_time,
		barg_unit = OLEDBSource@barg_unit,
		seasonal = OLEDBSource@seasonal,
		sal_plan_dflt = OLEDBSource@sal_plan_dflt,
		grade_dflt = OLEDBSource@grade_dflt,
		acct_cd = OLEDBSource@acct_cd,
		med_percent = OLEDBSource@med_percent,
		mos_percent = OLEDBSource@mos_percent,
		upp_percent = OLEDBSource@upp_percent,
		descrlong = descrlong,
		fte = OLEDBSource@fte,
		r = r,
		position_key = position_key,
		effective_from = effective_from,
		description = description,
		department = department,
		job_code = job_code,
		position_status = position_status,
		reports_to_key = reports_to_key,
		effective_status = effective_status,
		description_short = description_short,
		is_budgeted_position = is_budgeted_position,
		is_confidential_position = is_confidential_position,
		is_key_position = is_key_position,
		company_key = company_key,
		union_code = union_code,
		union_key = union_key,
		employment_type_key = employment_type_key,
		description_long = description_long
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupdimpositionSelect
LookupdimpositionSelect split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupdimpositionIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupdimpositionIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		{} as short
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		{} = Param_30)) ~> Update
LookupdimpositionIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		seasonal as string,
		position_status as string,
		shift as string,
		description as string,
		is_budgeted_position as string,
		sal_plan_dflt as string,
		reg_temp as string,
		barg_unit as string,
		effective_status as string,
		upp_percent as short,
		fte as integer,
		is_key_position as string,
		reports_to as string,
		acct_cd as string,
		union_code as string,
		mos_percent as short,
		company as string,
		job_code as string,
		department as string,
		effective_from as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		job_share as string,
		position_nbr as string,
		is_confidential_position as string,
		update_incumbents as string,
		std_hrs_default as integer,
		description_long as string,
		business_unit as string,
		description_short as string,
		full_part_time as string,
		grade_dflt as string,
		max_head_count as short,
		location as string,
		med_percent as short
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		seasonal,
		position_status = posn_status,
		shift,
		description = descr,
		is_budgeted_position = budgeted_posn,
		sal_plan_dflt,
		reg_temp,
		barg_unit,
		effective_status = eff_status,
		upp_percent,
		fte,
		is_key_position = key_position,
		reports_to,
		acct_cd,
		union_code = union_cd,
		mos_percent,
		company,
		job_code = jobcode,
		department = deptid,
		effective_from = effdt,
		job_share,
		position_nbr,
		is_confidential_position = confidential_posn,
		update_incumbents,
		std_hrs_default,
		description_long = descrlong,
		business_unit,
		description_short = descrshort,
		full_part_time,
		grade_dflt,
		max_head_count,
		location,
		med_percent)) ~> Insert
